chapter: Europe tours, Birdland memories and closing
title: The 1974 tour and the first Montreux Festival
summary: Cobb says he first played Montreux last year, went again in 1974 with Tiny Grimes and Panama Francis, and mentions seeing Sir Charles Thompson in Boston.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Did you play -- did you do the Montreux Festival at that time?
No, no, no. First time I ever done the Montreux Festival was last year, after we left out from Nice to go to do that, and we did the North Sea and Holland, yeah.
Well, that last year Letharschi was '77. '73 did you go again --
That was Tiny Grimes, Panama Francis, the piano player -- I'm trying to think of his name.
No, no, no, out of -- he doesn't live in (inaudible).
Where from here, out of where?
Lloyd Glenn, you hit it. Sir Charles I saw in Boston. He was working at a hotel up there. I saw him when I was up there with Lionel Hampton last week.
He come on the stage blowing a saxophone and disrupting rehearsal, cracked everybody up.
Too much. I'm listening, Boss Man.
